svg.text: PR-first and backend-owned. The service is the product; the extension is a thin client on top of it.
The Anthropic API key exists in exactly one place. Every surface calls the same engine.
Thin client — holds no API key
reviews · findings · accept/dismiss outcomes · coverage — server-observed, never client-reported
The system of record. Runs on every PR, cannot be skipped, reviews a coherent change instead of WIP commits.
push to a branch on GitHub
inline comments + check status = the real gate
Secondary flow — local pre-check in VS Code
Optional convenience so problems surface before push. Same backend, same ruleset, no API key on the laptop.
session auth, no key on disk
PR check remains the real gate
What changed from the first design
20 laptops holding an org API key is unrotatable
and unattributable. One service now owns the
key, the model config, and the ruleset version.
